text:
Priya Kapoor: Quick follow-up from the RFC — do we want a single global acceptance threshold for new models or a tiered one per workload class?
Mateo Rios: leaning towards tiered. image-search / chat have very different latency/quality tradeoffs.
Alice Chen: +1 on tiers. also we should differentiate perf vs quality thresholds (e.g. 95th latency vs LLM accuracy).
Samir Patel: Agreed. For perf-critical routes we can allow slightly lower MLP quality if latency is under SLO. for research routes, opposite.
Priya Kapoor: How do we capture that in the pipeline though? one config file per model? per route?
Mateo Rios: My proposal: pipeline accepts a JSON policy bundle with keys: {"route_class","quality_threshold","latency_threshold","kv_cache_ok"}. validators run both bench and a tiny runtime smoke.
Alice Chen: Sounds good. we should also store the exact evaluation set fingerprint so we can repro. e.g. bench_meta: "goldset_v3_sha256:abc..."
Samir Patel: One tradeoff: more tiers == more maintenance. maybe start with 3 buckets: interactive, background, embeddings. keep it simple.
Priya Kapoor: What about quantization compatibility? we need to ensure int8 model passes functional parity checks before allowing it in interactive tier.
Mateo Rios: Yes — add a step: quant-compat check that runs n=200 golden prompts and compares normalized token-level overlap > 0.98. fallback to float16 if fails.
Alice Chen: Also consider KV cache ABI changes. If model's KV layout changes we need a compatibility shim or we block the model. that should be explicit in policy: "kv_abi": "stable|shim|required".
Samir Patel: Operationally, can onboard-bot enforce these? onboard-bot: run checks on PR and post results.
onboard-bot: automated: acceptance checks queued. running: bench -> latency -> quant-compat -> kv-abi -> golden-replay. ETA ~ 12m.
Priya Kapoor: Nice. final ask: can we surface a human review flag if any threshold was relaxed to get model in? I'd like an audit trail.
Mateo Rios: add metadata: {"relax_reason","approver","diff_link"} to the model registry entry.
Alice Chen: I'll draft a tiny RFC doc with the policy JSON schema and sample workflows. will ping for review. :eyes:
Samir Patel: Thanks — if you include example CLI invocations that helps ops. e.g. `ri-onboard run --policy=policy.json --goldset=gold_v3.tgz`
Priya Kapoor: perfect. closing the thread unless anyone has concerns. :thumbsup:
